correctness.rationale: For any peak above 1/2 the three feasible fractions have exact ranks (1,2,0) for zero, one, or two same-colored neighbors. Swapping nonadjacent opposite colors maps k to 2-k and improves both exactly at two monochromatic run interiors; swapping adjacent opposite colors maps k to 1-k and improves both exactly at two isolated vertices. This proves the complete forbidden-pattern criterion. Explicit constructions establish existence except b=r=3; a cyclic-run case split proves that exception. Transfer-trace inclusion-exclusion counts labeled cyclic words, and primitive Perron–Frobenius with exact integer characteristic polynomials proves asymptotic rarity. A standalone direct oracle checked all 65502 mixed words and 3014652 opposite-color pairs for 3<=n<=15; exact characteristic checks passed. Finite verification does not substitute for the all-size proof.

originality.rationale: The high-peak parent paper proves only the nonexistence example C6,b=r=3 (Theorem 2), while the present result proves the all-size positive complement, a necessary-and-sufficient forbidden-factor language, exact labeled counts and exponentially small random prevalence. All relevant parent model, ring theorem and concluding discussion were read. Distinct related models (monotone swap, vacancy jump, low-peak tied-utility rings) do not imply this exact high-peak statement. Semantic mathematical-record queries and web primary-paper searches found no equivalent, although absent matches do not establish priority.
residual_risks: No specialist can guarantee publication priority from searches alone; an equivalent all-size ring enumeration may appear under alternative phrasing or in a database not located.
Semantic mathematical-record search returns a ranked subset, so absence of a near-identical hit is not a proof of originality.

value.rationale: Determining if the known six-cycle failure is isolated is a natural structural question for a degree-two game family. The theorem closes existence for all color compositions on cycles and derives the complete equilibrium spectrum, then reveals that nonempty equilibrium sets can occupy exponentially small fractions of random colorings. The exact transfer-root rate is a motivated model statistic and not an arbitrary slice or recomputation of a known table.
